name: AI 활용
when: AI에 문서·웹페이지·메일을 읽히거나 요약시키는 기능, AI API 호출, 문서 검색 답변(RAG), AI 답변을 화면·판단에 쓰는 기능
route: LLM/AI API calls (openai, anthropic, gemini), prompts and system messages, RAG/vector search, rendering or executing model output, AI endpoints without limits

name: AI 코딩 도구
when: AI 코딩 도구에 코드 작성·설정 변경·명령 실행을 맡기는 경우
route: agent tools and tool_calls, MCP config (.mcp.json), agent memory and loops, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.cursorrules, .claude/settings.json permissions

name: 외부 데이터 수집·처리
when: 외부 URL·파일·XML·압축 파일을 가져와 읽거나 파싱하는 경우
route: server-side URL fetch (requests, fetch, axios, curl), XML parsing, zip/tar extraction, pickle/yaml.load/unserialize, image/PDF/office file processing

name: 자동 수집 대응
when: 내 사이트·API가 자동 수집(크롤링) 대상이 되는 경우
route: public list, search and download endpoints, page size params (limit, per_page), rate limiting, X-Forwarded-For

name: 웹 애플리케이션
when: 입력을 받아 DB·화면·파일·명령으로 넘기는 웹 기능
route: SQL built from strings, raw queries (execute, query, whereRaw, knex.raw), ORDER BY or column names from request, HTML output ({!!, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, |safe), CSRF exemptions and cookie-auth POST handlers, shell commands (exec, subprocess), templates and eval, MongoDB/LDAP filters, file paths and downloads, file uploads (multer, UploadFile, move_uploaded_file), redirects from next/returnUrl, mail and response headers, regexes and page-size limits, coupon/points/balance updates, catch/except blocks and error responses, DB connections and amounts, debug routes and global request state, reverse DNS checks and extract()

name: 인증·인가
route: routes loading records by id, routes/Server Actions without auth, admin pages and dashboards (Telescope, Django admin), role/is_admin checks, mass assignment (fill, $request->all(), __all__), login and rate limits, password hashing, sessions/JWT/cookies, OAuth callbacks, SMS/OTP codes, identity verification results, payment confirm and webhooks, price/amount from request, signup/coupon/reservation flows

name: 설정·배포
route: .env and config files, docker-compose, CI workflows, API keys/tokens/passwords in code, VITE_/NEXT_PUBLIC_ env vars, secrets in logs, debug flags (APP_DEBUG, DEBUG, debug=True), CORS settings, security headers (CSP, HSTS, add_header), storage buckets and published ports

name: 개인정보 보호
route: Supabase (createClient, RLS policies, service_role keys), Firebase security rules and firebase-admin, personal data storage, queries, logs and exports

name: 소프트웨어 공급망
route: adding dependencies (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, composer.json), lockfiles, package install commands, new imports

name: 모바일 앱
when: React Native·Expo·Flutter 등 모바일 앱의 저장·통신·딥링크·WebView
route: mobile app storage (AsyncStorage, SecureStore, Keychain, Keystore, SharedPreferences), HTTP/TLS settings, deep links and intent filters, WebView, bundled secrets in app code
